subtopic: Mean, Median and Mode of Grouped Data
stem:
The classification of children according to their ages, playing on a ground is shown in the following table. Find the mode of ages of the children.

| Age-group of children (Yrs) | 6-8 | 8-10 | 10-12 | 12-14 | 14-16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No. of children | 43 | 58 | 70 | 42 | 27 |
solution:
From the table, the maximum number of children is of the age-group 10-12. So the modal class is 10-12.

Here \(f_1 = 70\), and the modal class is 10-12. \(\therefore\) in the given example,

\(L\) = Lower class limit of the modal class = 10

\(h\) = Class interval of the modal class = 2

\(f_1\) = Frequency of the modal class = 70

\(f_0\) = Frequency of the class preceding the modal class = 58

\(f_2\) = Frequency of the class succeeding the modal class = 42

Mode \(= L + \left[\dfrac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2}\right] \times h\)

\(= 10 + \left[\dfrac{70 - 58}{2(70) - 58 - 42}\right] \times 2 = 10 + \left[\dfrac{12}{140 - 100}\right] \times 2 = 10 + \dfrac{12}{40} \times 2\)

\(= 10 + \dfrac{24}{40} = 10 + 0.6 = 10.6\)

\(\therefore\) the mode of the ages of children playing on the ground is 10.6 years.

subtopic: Mean, Median and Mode of Grouped Data
stem:
The following frequency distribution table shows the classification of the number of vehicles and the volume of petrol filled in them. Find the mode of the volume.

| Petrol filled (Litre) | 1-3 | 4-6 | 7-9 | 10-12 | 13-15 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No. of vehicle | 33 | 40 | 27 | 18 | 12 |
solution:
The given classes are not continuous. So let us make them continuous and rewrite the table.

| Class | Continuous classes | Frequency |
|---|---|---|
| 1-3 | 0.5-3.5 | 33 \(\to f_0\) |
| 4-6 | 3.5-6.5 | 40 \(\to f_1\) |
| 7-9 | 6.5-9.5 | 27 \(\to f_2\) |
| 10-12 | 9.5-12.5 | 18 |
| 13-15 | 12.5-15.5 | 12 |

From the above table, the modal class is 3.5-6.5, so \(L = 3.5\) and \(h = 3\).

Mode \(= L + \left[\dfrac{f_1 - f_0}{2f_1 - f_0 - f_2}\right] \times h\)

\(= 3.5 + \left[\dfrac{40 - 33}{2(40) - 33 - 27}\right] \times 3 = 3.5 + \left[\dfrac{7}{80 - 60}\right] \times 3\)

\(= 3.5 + \dfrac{21}{20} = 3.5 + 1.05 = 4.55\)

\(\therefore\) the mode of the volume of petrol filled is 4.55 litre.
